name: Remnant of the Fallen
source:
Take on the role of a young sorceress as she makes her way in a world that refuses to let her live in peace. Worldly and supernatural forces battle for her allegiance just as powerful men vie for her heart. Will she become a queen or a renegade, a prisoner or a rescuer? Will she uncover the mysteries of her heritage or reject it altogether? The choices are yours. 

[From [url=https://alightgames.itch.io/remnant-of-the-fallen]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
扮演一名年轻女巫的角色，在一个不允许她和平生活的世界中奋力前行。世俗和超自然的力量争夺她的忠诚，就像强大的男人争夺她的心一样。她会成为女王还是叛徒，囚犯还是救援者？她会揭开她的遗产之谜还是完全拒绝它？选择是你的。

[来自[url=https://alightgames.itch.io/remnant-of-the-fallen]itch.io[/url]]
